atlarixAuto.consentWhy: Atlarix Auto costs nothing. It is free because the prompts and replies it handles are shared with OpenAI, which may use them to improve its models.
atlarixAuto.consentCare: Don't use it for code or data you can't share. Every other model — Core tiers and your own API keys — is not shared, and neither is Auto once you have Pro or credit: then it is paid and private.
atlarixAuto.consentShare: Everyone gets a fair daily share; when yours is used, Auto moves to a free fallback model, then pauses until the daily reset.
atlarixAuto.statusTitle: Atlarix Auto picks the model for each step.
atlarixAuto.strongerModelTitle: Run this turn again with Auto one level up. Costs more.
atlarixAuto.deepThinkingHint: On: Auto uses stronger models for this chat — costs more.
atlarixAuto.rowPrivate: Private — never used to train models
atlarixAuto.privateTitle: Paid Atlarix Auto is private: your prompts and code are never shared or used to train models.
